stop_condition: R4-F1 verified fixed with its new negative controls proven to FIRE by mutation rather than read; R4-F2 and R4-F3 verified; the ninth surface verified; and a final sweep of every remaining consumer of design_reviewer_lane confirming no surface still asserts or enacts a design-lane effect that does not exist.

findings.evidence: statusline.sh:325 still reads: if [ "$total" -eq 1 ] && [ "$rlane" = "claude" ] && [ "$dlane" = "claude" ]; then — gating the compact ' • model: X' form on the design lane. BEFORE the R4-F1 fix this conjunct was redundant-but-harmless: a non-claude design lane rendered dsr as 'sol', so total was always >= 2 and the total -eq 1 arm was unreachable. AFTER the fix it is LIVE and changes output. Simulated: five roles all resolving to fable-5 with rlane=claude — dlane=claude renders ' • model: fable-5', dlane=codex renders ' • des+dsr+orch+impl+rev:fable-5'. Same reality, two renderings, differing only on a lane that no longer affects anything. Reachable on any account listing one family, since <family>-class falls back to top per model-roles' own documented fallback. This makes the newly written model-roles:93-99 inaccurate on two counts: it says design_reviewer_lane 'changes neither the reviewer nor ... the statusline', and that 'Its only remaining effect is ... it suppresses the identity-collapse flag'. There is a second remaining effect and it is this line. Confirmed by sweep: statusline.sh:325 and model-select.sh:1390 (the yvpe defect itself) are the only two behavioural uses of dlane left; model-select.sh:1438's lane_note is a factual key=value report and asserts nothing.
findings.description: MEDIUM, not HIGH, and the distinction is the one R4-F1 turned on: this asserts nothing false to an operator. Both renderings show the same correct information — the design reviewer's real resolved id — so nobody is misled about who reviews their design. The cost is a vestigial guard and, more importantly, an absolute claim in the canonical config file that a maintainer picking up yvpe would reasonably trust: reading 'only remaining effect', they would leave :325 in place. Deleting the '&& [ "$dlane" = "claude" ]' conjunct fixes the code and makes the documentation true in one edit. Belongs with yvpe.
